content.value: A diffraction pattern of a cubic crystal of lattice parameter a = 3.16 Å is obtained with a (12) monochromatic X-rays beam of wavelength 1.54 Å. The first line on this pattern was observed to have θ = 20.30°. Determine the interplanar spacing and the Miller Indices of the reflecting plane.
